limitations.note: The rewrite left yellow and red combinational instead of registering them from the pre-edge balance, and changed the unrelated billing logic to deduct the rate on recharge cycles rather than give recharge priority.
The passing test expected red to assert immediately after reset release, before a rising edge, and expected recharge and deduction on the same edge, so it reinforced both incorrect assumptions.
